001package org.clafer.choco.constraint;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import java.util.HashSet;
005import java.util.Set;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Constraint;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012import static org.chocosolver.util.ESat.TRUE;
013import static org.chocosolver.util.ESat.UNDEFINED;
014
015/**
016 * Boolean or. The difference between this constraint and the one provided by
017 * the library is that this one does not reify to boolean variables, thus it can
018 * be added after the search has started. The one provided in the library
019 * requires dynamic variable addition which is not supported.
020 *
021 * @author jimmy
022 */
023public class OrConstraint extends Constraint {
024
025    public OrConstraint(Constraint... constraints) {
026        super("or", new PropOr(buildArray(constraints), constraints));
027    }
028
029    private static Variable[] buildArray(Constraint... constraints) {
030        Set<Variable> vars = new HashSet<>();
031        for (Constraint constraint : constraints) {
032            for (Propagator propagator : constraint.getPropagators()) {
033                vars.addAll(Arrays.asList(propagator.getVars()));
034                propagator.setReifiedSilent(null);
035            }
036        }
037        return vars.toArray(new Variable[vars.size()]);
038    }
039
040    private static class PropOr extends Propagator<Variable> {
041
042        private final Constraint[] constraints;
043
044        protected PropOr(Variable[] vars, Constraint[] constraints) {
045            super(vars, PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, false);
046            this.constraints = constraints;
047        }
048
049        @Override
050        public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
051            boolean allFalse = true;
052            for (Constraint constraint : constraints) {
053                switch (constraint.isSatisfied()) {
054                    case TRUE:
055                        setPassive();
056                        return;
057                    case UNDEFINED:
058                        allFalse = false;
059                        break;
060                }
061            }
062            if (allFalse) {
063                fails();
064            }
065        }
066
067        @Override
068        public ESat isEntailed() {
069            boolean allFalse = true;
070            for (Constraint constraint : constraints) {
071                switch (constraint.isSatisfied()) {
072                    case TRUE:
073                        return ESat.TRUE;
074                    case UNDEFINED:
075                        allFalse = false;
076                        break;
077                }
078            }
079            return allFalse ? ESat.FALSE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
080        }
081    }
082}
